description: Address the v1 semantic code review (.agents/tasks/task-wire-real-connectors/2026-08-27-124948-review.md, verdict NEEDS_CHANGES) that found the real-connector wiring was not yet genuinely correct. Fix the three blocking findings (Razorpay INDETERMINATE path being dead code / outcome collapse on a post-effect timeout; the CTP-signed evidence envelope being discarded so the 'signed receipt' was only reference strings; reconciliation comparing unrelated amounts so real success runs spuriously mismatch) and resolve or explicitly justify the non-blocking findings. Preserve the hard invariants and all previously passing tests.
steps: Issue #1 (Razorpay INDETERMINATE unreachable): map the real-http-client's synthetic 503 transport-failure body in RazorpayTestProvider.createInstruction. A body with error.reason === 'timeout' now returns kind:'indeterminate' (reference=idempotencyKey, queryAfter=+30s); reason === 'network' or any other non-200 (a genuine Razorpay 4xx/5xx with no such marker) still throws UNAVAILABLE, so existing error mapping is unchanged. This makes the razorpayResult.kind === 'indeterminate'/'declined' branches in real-lifecycle.ts reachable so a post-effect Razorpay timeout surfaces as INDETERMINATE with a recorded receipt (invariant #2), not a generic retryable throw.

Issue #2 (CTP envelope discarded): added an optional signedEvidence field to PaymentAuthorizationResult and TransactionReceipt. real-lifecycle.ts now extracts evidence.providerData.envelope (the CTP-signed envelope from CounterTestPaymentProvider) via extractSignedEvidence() and returns it on the captured outcome; the handler threads it into all three sink.record() calls (captured, indeterminate, reconciliation-mismatch). The signed envelope now reaches the receipt/outbox (invariant #3, FEAT-004 AC). It carries references/status/signature only, never secrets.

Issue #3 (reconciliation compares unrelated amounts): reconciliation now uses the amount actually captured through the PAYMENT rail (authorizeCapture returns capturedMinor = request.amountMinor, the amount handed to authorize/capture), compared like-for-like against the intended amount. The Shopify order total (variant price x qty) is independent catalog data and is preserved as audit evidence on the providerReference (shopify_total_minor:...) but no longer drives reconciliation, so a genuine success reconciles instead of spuriously going INDETERMINATE. A REAL mismatch (provider capturing a different amount) still routes to INDETERMINATE via the handler's unchanged reconciliation check.

Issue #4 (missing Razorpay-side failure test): added apps/worker/src/real-lifecycle.test.ts cases: (a) a Razorpay order timeout AFTER a successful draft surfaces INDETERMINATE, does not run finalize/mark-paid, and does not double-create; (b) the handler routes that timeout to a retryable payment.indeterminate error AFTER recording an INDETERMINATE-phase receipt; (c) the CTP-signed envelope reaches receipt.signedEvidence (type counter.evidence.v1 with signature+payload) and no secrets leak; (d) a genuine success reconciles even when the Shopify order total (12345 minor) differs from the intended amount (4999). Added packages/razorpay-adapter/src/razorpay-provider.test.ts cases proving reason:'timeout' -> indeterminate and reason:'network' -> thrown UNAVAILABLE. These tests fail under the pre-fix behavior.

Issue #5 (Shopify restart idempotency): DOCUMENTED as a known limitation in the real-lifecycle.ts header (RESTART BOUNDARY note). Within a live port instance the at-most-one-effect guarantee holds (proven by the in-process replay test); across a worker restart both the outcomeCache and the Shopify ActionPorts' in-memory dedup are lost, leaving only Razorpay's server-side X-Razorpay-Idempotency as a cross-restart guard. Persisting the idempotencyKey->effect correlation is deferred to the durable-resume milestone. Justified rather than fixed: durable resume is out of scope for this task (real-connector wiring) and would require outbox/DB schema changes.

Issue #6 (verify:real prints unsigned receipt): FIXED as a consequence of #2. scripts/verify-real-transaction.mjs step 8 now prints receipt.signedEvidence (the CTP envelope) and warns if it is absent.
acceptance_criteria: A Razorpay post-effect timeout surfaces as INDETERMINATE (not a thrown/failed outcome) with a recorded receipt and no double-create (invariant #2).
The CTP-signed envelope is carried into the receipt (receipt.signedEvidence), not discarded (invariant #3).
A genuine success reconciles even when the Shopify order total differs from the intended amount; a real mismatch still becomes INDETERMINATE.
No try/catch->failed collapse; explicit outcomes preserved across both the Shopify and Razorpay legs (invariant #1).
No raw payment credentials/PAN/CVV/UPI PIN in receipts/logs; env-gating unchanged (invariants #5/#6).
New tests fail under the pre-fix behavior and pass after the fix.
pnpm build passes; pnpm test >= 2758 with creds-gated suites skipping cleanly; pnpm depcruise clean; verify:real prints SKIPPED and exits 0 without creds.

findings: All three blocking findings fixed and non-blocking findings resolved (#4/#6 fixed, #5 justified/documented). Razorpay outcome mapping preserved the PaymentOperationResult union (which already has indeterminate/declined kinds), so no existing razorpay-adapter test regressed (61 -> 63, +2 new). Worker real-lifecycle tests 5 -> 8 (+4 new including the two proving the pre-fix bugs). Full suite 2758 -> 2764. depcruise clean. verify:real still SKIPPED exit 0.
